name: torch
notes: Built from source at tag v1.0.0 (commit bb39229) with CMake 4.4.2 and Apple clang 21, with -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5, -DFMT_CONSTEVAL= for bundled fmt, and a compiler wrapper adding -Wno-parentheses -Wno-chained-comparison (upstream src/audio/AudioManager.cpp uses chained comparisons that Apple clang 21 rejects). Those flags are not in the repo; the binary in bin/ is the result. The test uses only self-made inputs (a text folder and a 64 KB fake ROM). Verified 2026-10-16.
